project_type: Immersive Editorial Fan Archive / Unified Spatial React SPA

theme_strategy.description: Dark cinematic visual language. Deep Obsidian base with 3-team persistent accent variables.

technical.usage: For markers, stats, context labels, tracking-widest, uppercase.

editorial.family: Playfair Display, or native serif italic
editorial.usage: Expressive story quotes, overlapping elements to break the rigid tech grid.

rules: NO generic full-screen gradients. Use texture (noise, grain, paper).
Contrast first. Dark themes use bg-black/30 over images, NEVER darker than 50%.
Themed accent color applied to active states, scroll progress lines, and key markers.

VisualGallery.container: 100svh fixed container, relative positioning. Hides overflow.
VisualGallery.safe_zones: Absolute positioned overlay at top/bottom corners for 'Back to Circuit' and 'CH. 04'. High z-index (z-50), mix-blend-difference or frosted glassmorphism to ensure contrast. MUST NOT scroll.
VisualGallery.grid_structure: Asymmetrical 2-column layout. Left (40% width): Pinned editorial context, active category, animated progress bar. Right (60% width): The 'Photo Stack'.
VisualGallery.photo_stack: Instead of a generic horizontal carousel, stack images directly on top of each other absolutely. As the user scrolls, the active image reveals via clip-path from bottom to top, while the previous image slightly scales down.

scroll_trap_logic.mechanism: Capture onWheel and onTouchMove events within VisualGallery. Prevent default body scrolling while inside.
scroll_trap_logic.navigation: Internal index (0 to N-1). Scrolling down increases index. Scrolling up decreases. Add a 800ms debounce/throttle to prevent skipping photos.
scroll_trap_logic.release_condition: If at index 0 and scrolling up -> fire 'previousChapter()'. If at index N-1 and scrolling down -> fire 'nextChapter()'. DO NOT alter global spatial camera coordinates directly; call the provided boundary callbacks.

photo_transitions.enter: clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0). scale: 1.1 to 1.0. duration: 0.85s, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] (custom framer-motion easing).
photo_transitions.exit: scale: 1.0 to 0.95, filter: blur(4px) and brightness(0.6). duration: 0.85s.

motion.reduced_motion: Detect prefers-reduced-motion. Fallback to simple crossfade opacity changes. Maintain scroll-trap logic.

VisualGallery.jsx: Use pure Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion. DO NOT use generic Shadcn cards.
Build a monolithic, full-screen editorial component.
Render a vertical progress indicator (e.g., a 1px vertical line that fills with the team accent color).
Each photo must include a large floating Typography number (e.g., '01', '02') using Unbounded outline style.
CSS: Add bespoke clip-path utilities if needed, or rely on framer-motion inline styles.
Ensure the gallery container has touch-action: none to prevent native mobile scroll when trapping.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
